title: Memory-Centric Continual Learning for AI Agents
abstract: arXiv:2610.29357v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Autonomous agents powered by foundation models can reason, plan, and use tools, but their fixed weights and context limits hinder sustained learning from experience over long-term deployment. While external memory systems attempt to bridge this gap, they mostly act as passive retrieval caches, evaluated primarily by whether they can recall stored facts or past interactions. Whether memory can drive genuine continual learning remains an open question. In this paper, we introduce Memory-Centric Continual Learning (MCCL), arguing that memory should be judged by whether it improves future actions, not merely what it retrieves. MCCL has three main parts. First, a three-axis taxonomy organizes memory by where state is stored (substrates), what form it takes (assets), and how it is managed (policies). translated_title: 面向AI智能体的以记忆为中心的持续学习
translated_abstract: 由基础模型驱动的自主智能体能够进行推理、规划和使用工具，但其固定的权重和有限的上下文窗口阻碍了它们在长期部署中从经验里持续学习。尽管外部记忆系统试图弥合这一差距，但它们大多充当被动的检索缓存，评估标准主要是能否召回存储的事实或过往交互。记忆能否驱动真正的持续学习仍是一个悬而未决的问题。在本文中，我们提出了以记忆为中心的持续学习（MCCL），主张应当以记忆能否改善未来的行动来评判其价值，而不仅仅是看它检索到什么。MCCL包含三个主要部分：首先，一个三轴分类体系从状态存储的位置（基底）、状态的形态（资产）以及状态的管理方式（策略）三个维度组织记忆；其次，定义了一个双循环生命周期，在内循环中更新记忆状态，同时在外循环中基于任务反馈不断完善管理策略。
tldr: 本文提出以记忆为中心的持续学习框架（MCCL），主张以记忆能否改善智能体未来行动而非检索效果作为评判标准，并通过三轴记忆分类体系和内外双循环的生命周期机制，使AI智能体能够真正实现从经验中持续学习。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes Memory-Centric Continual Learning (MCCL), a framework that judges memory by whether it improves an agent's future actions rather than mere retrieval, organizing memory through a three-axis taxonomy and a two-loop lifecycle to enable genuine continual learning for AI agents.
